verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents an official web tracking snippet and a JavaScript integration that is '100% compatible with Segment API', plus a React integration, which implies the track/identify/page spec. Identify events are explicitly referenced through Profile Builder traits. Server-side collection is documented only through a raw HTTP API rather than an SDK, and the evidence never mentions a mobile SDK. missing for 10: official mobile SDKs, official server-side SDKs beyond the HTTP API, an explicitly documented tracking spec covering track/page calls, independent hands-on corroboration of the SDKs.
